newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: G10 central bankers judge currency markets quiet.
newsitem.headline: G10 central bankers judge currency markets quiet.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said central bank governors from the Group of 10 (G10) industrial nations saw world currency markets as relatively quiet at the moment.
He said foreign exchange markets were not a topic of discussion at today's meeting because of the relative calm.

"We have not discussed the currency markets because it seems all in all relatively quiet now," Tietmeyer said in his role as chairman of the G10 central bank governors committee. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
